note: The simulator never reads the text. A template's effect is a random draw per world, unrelated to its wording. These comparisons test whether the selection policy finds and rotates the templates with the largest drawn effects; they say nothing about whether the generated copy is good or which wording works better for real users.
settings_note: Settings are points drawn uniformly over the parameter box, not probabilities of the real world.
metric: opens per user over the 28 days, averaged over the run seeds
